setting: A fictional, grounded premodern walled city-state, roughly late Iron Age or early medieval technology. No magic, no monsters. The player stands on a dirt road outside the city with only ordinary physical ability and bare hands.

known_here: iron and bronze smithing, nails, simple locks
lodestone as a curiosity that pulls iron (but not magnetised needles or compasses)
levers, ramps, rollers, a single fixed pulley, ropes, wedges
cords and rods for measuring, balance scales, sundials
writing among a few clerks and priests
unknown_here: compound pulleys (block and tackle), gears for mechanical advantage
distillation, siphons as a technique, germ theory

material_facts.wood: Rigid; cuttable or scrapable with a sharp edge; burns when dry; floats; can be split along the grain.
material_facts.bark: Flexible when fresh or damp, brittle when dry; can be peeled into strips; floats; burns.
material_facts.reed: Hollow, light, rigid stems; float well; can be bundled; split with a sharp edge.
material_facts.dry grass: Light, flexible, very combustible; can be twisted into weak cord or bundled as tinder.
material_facts.vine: Flexible, tough, tieable like rope; about as strong as thin rope when fresh.
material_facts.plant fiber: Twisted fibres; flexible and tieable; short cord holds light loads (about 10 kg).
material_facts.pine resin: Sticky when warmed or worked in the hand, hardens when cool; burns with a smoky flame; works as a weak glue.
material_facts.flint: Hard, brittle stone that fractures into very sharp edges; can cut and scrape wood, bark, cord and vine. Striking it on steel makes sparks; striking it on ordinary stone does not reliably light anything.
material_facts.stone: Rigid and heavy; usable as a hammer, weight, anvil or fulcrum; does not burn or cut unless it is flint.
material_facts.iron: Ferromagnetic; can be magnetised by a real magnet such as lodestone; forgeable only with a forge.
material_facts.bronze: Not ferromagnetic; cannot be magnetised; can be polished into a mirror.
material_facts.lodestone: A natural magnet; attracts iron and can magnetise small iron pieces.
material_facts.water: Liquid; needs a container; light objects float on it.
material_facts.cloth: Flexible, cuttable, can wrap or filter.
material_facts.fire: There is NO fire, ember or heat source available to the player on the road. Nothing can be lit, cooked, hardened in fire or melted unless a burning or heat-source item is listed.

flag_meanings.sharp_edge: can cut or pierce soft materials
flag_meanings.tieable: can be tied around or to things
flag_meanings.container: can hold loose things or liquid
flag_meanings.magnetized: is itself a weak magnet (needs a real magnet to create)
flag_meanings.light_source: currently gives off light (must actually be burning)
flag_meanings.heat_source: currently gives off heat (must actually be burning)
flag_meanings.stable_support: stands steady and can bear weight
